title: Prepare for Forever, Try Midnight’s Talebound, and Discover Sweet Treats in WoW Weekly
author: Blizzard Entertainment

short_news.title_en: Prepare for Forever, Try Midnight’s Talebound, and Discover Sweet Treats in WoW Weekly

path: World of Warcraft: Forever Goes Live Globally November 4!
changes.text: Begin your first adventure or return to a new and reimagined Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever, launching worldwide November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST. Adventure to level 60 across the original continents, discover new stories, and meet fellow adventurers in a permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW, where community comes first, and the journey matters as much as the destination.

path: New Player’s Starter Guide: Welcome to World of Warcraft: Forever
changes.text: World of Warcraft: Forever invites players into a reimagined original Azeroth where exploration, community, and the journey itself take center stage.

path: New Player’s Starter Guide: Welcome to World of Warcraft: Forever
changes.text: Your first steps in Azeroth begin with a few meaningful choices: how you want to play, who you want your character to become, and where curiosity will lead you. Start at level one, shape a character of your own, and learn the essentials to find your place in a world designed to unfold for years to come.

path: Return to Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever
changes.text: Welcome back to Azeroth. Whether it's been a few years or many, familiar roads, old friends, and new adventures await you in World of Warcraft: Forever.

path: Return to Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever
changes.text: To help you get your feet on the ground and begin your adventures in Azeroth once more, we’ve put together some information you may need to return to your hero’s journey.

path: Watch the WoW: Forever Podcast: All About Tech
changes.text: Join WoW: Forever Podcast host Countdown To Classic and special guest Shobek as they talk tech with Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield, Lead Software Engineer Ana Resendez, and Principal Software Engineer Frank Williams.

path: Your Next Adventure in WoW: Forever Starts in the WoW Portal Room
changes.text: Azeroth has always been more than a place to play—it is a world shaped by the people we meet along the way. The WoW Portal Room offers a starting point for making those connections, whether you’re searching for familiar camaraderie or an entirely new circle of adventurers.

path: Your Next Adventure in WoW: Forever Starts in the WoW Portal Room
changes.text: The WoW Portal Room is ready to welcome World of Warcraft: Forever players and help them build on the friendships, stories, and shared adventures that make Azeroth feel like home.

path: Watch the WoW: Forever Short Story, “Unbowed”
changes.text: Cormack, a former Scarlet Crusader in life, now raised as Forsaken, struggles to accept his undead existence.

path: Satisfy Your Sweet Tooth in November’s Trading Post
changes.text: Visit T&W (Tawney and Wilder) just outside the Mage District in Stormwind, or the Zen’shiri Trading Post next to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar, to check out the latest items they have available. Players can also visit the Trading Post in the capital cities of Dornogal (The Foregrounds) on the Isle of Dorn and in the renewed Silvermoon City, where representatives of both Tawney and Wilder and the Zen’shiri Trading Post are open for business.

path: Add the Living Heartsbane Cauldron Mount to your Collection
changes.text: Rising from the remnants of a dark ritual, this living cauldron bears the marks of the witchcraft that awakened it. Take command of this cursed creation and ride across Azeroth in wicked style.

path: Add the Living Heartsbane Cauldron Mount to your Collection
changes.text: The Living Heartsbane Cauldron is a delightfully macabre mount, ready to whisk you into adventures by ground or sky.
